name: Neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis type 7 (CLN7 / MFSD8 disease)

reference.source: Neurogenetics and inherited metabolic disease references
clinicalPearls: CLN7 is a variant late-infantile NCL caused by biallelic variants in MFSD8, first characterised in Turkish families.
MFSD8 encodes a lysosomal transmembrane protein of the major facilitator superfamily, a putative transporter, so CLN7 is not an enzyme-deficiency subtype.
Typical onset is in early childhood with seizures that are often myoclonic, developmental regression, ataxia, progressive visual failure and speech decline.
Certain hypomorphic MFSD8 variants cause an isolated, non-syndromic macular or retinal dystrophy without neurodegeneration, a much milder allelic phenotype.
Electron microscopy shows fingerprint, curvilinear and rectilinear inclusions, and stored material is rich in subunit c of mitochondrial ATP synthase.
MRI demonstrates early and prominent cerebellar atrophy with later cerebral atrophy and thalamic and white-matter change.
Diagnosis is molecular; enzyme assays are unremarkable.
A photoparoxysmal EEG response to low-rate photic stimulation is characteristic of the late-infantile NCL group, including CLN7.
reference.pathophysiology: CLN7 disease is an autosomal recessive neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis caused by biallelic variants in MFSD8, also designated CLN7, on chromosome 4q28. MFSD8 encodes a polytopic lysosomal membrane protein belonging to the major facilitator superfamily, a large group of secondary active transporters; its precise transported substrate remains to be fully defined, but its loss disrupts lysosomal homeostasis. Impaired MFSD8 function leads to accumulation of autofluorescent ceroid-lipofuscin rich in subunit c of mitochondrial ATP synthase, with fingerprint, curvilinear and rectilinear inclusions on electron microscopy, and drives progressive neuronal and retinal degeneration. Genotype-phenotype correlation is notable: complete loss-of-function alleles produce the severe variant late-infantile neurodegenerative disease, whereas certain hypomorphic missense variants cause an isolated, non-syndromic macular and retinal dystrophy without systemic neurodegeneration.
additionalDifferentials: CLN5, CLN6 and CLN8 variant late-infantile NCLs
Non-syndromic inherited retinal dystrophies (for the isolated MFSD8 retinal phenotype)
additionalInvestigations: Molecular genetic testing (MFSD8 sequencing, NCL gene panel or exome sequencing)
Brain MRI, expecting early cerebellar atrophy
Electroretinography with detailed retinal imaging (optical coherence tomography and fundus autofluorescence)
Electron microscopy of skin or conjunctival biopsy
Ophthalmology review, particularly for the isolated retinal phenotype
redFlags: Developmental regression with new seizures in early childhood
Progressive visual loss with retinal dystrophy
reference.prognosis: Neurodegenerative CLN7 is relentlessly progressive, with early loss of skills and death commonly in childhood to adolescence; the isolated MFSD8 retinal dystrophy phenotype is far milder and non-lethal. Management is supportive.
pitfalls: Overlooking MFSD8 in an isolated retinal dystrophy that lacks neurological features.
Assuming an enzyme deficiency; CLN7 requires genetic diagnosis.
Restricting suspicion to Turkish ancestry; CLN7 occurs worldwide.
Mislabelling it as classic CLN2 and expecting cerliponase alfa to help.
management: No licensed disease-modifying therapy exists, so management is supportive and multidisciplinary
Control the often myoclonic seizures with antiepileptic drugs, avoiding agents that aggravate myoclonus
Provide physiotherapy, occupational therapy and antispasticity management for developmental regression and ataxia

Arrange ophthalmology and low-vision support for progressive retinal degeneration, while the isolated MFSD8 macular or retinal dystrophy phenotype needs ophthalmic surveillance without neurodegenerative care
Support nutrition and swallowing with gastrostomy feeding as bulbar function declines
Coordinate neurology, rehabilitation, palliative care and educational support
Offer genetic counselling and family screening for this autosomal recessive disorder
